generation.prompt: Create ONE finished transparent horizontal UK dealership logo proposal with exact text CARS AND on the first line and VAN. A simple original CV monogram with one horizontal road baseline, broad open counters. Strong humanist sans CARS AND above VAN, no slogan. Compact isolated icon at far LEFT occupies about 22 percent width; wordmark to right occupies 65 percent; wide fully transparent gap between icon and lettering so icon can be cropped separately. Flat #1b3348 ink fills letters and forms, with a bold clean solid WHITE KEYLINE around each outside edge and counter. White keyline is integral to this dual-contrast transparent identity so it reads on white, charcoal and red backgrounds. Clear professional small-size legibility, restrained precise typography, no other text, no city unless specified in the exact name. No background rectangle, shadows, gradient, texture, grunge, distress, 3D, metallic effect, glow, mockup or photos. True transparent alpha margins on a wide 3:1 canvas; exactly one complete logo.

generationVariants.prompt: Edit this exact attached dealership logo into its strong DARK-BACKGROUND VARIANT. Preserve exact geometry, icon, letters, wordmark spelling, line arrangement, proportions and spacing. Change ONLY the dark/navy interior ink of letters and compact icon strokes to SOLID OPAQUE PALE SILVER #d9e2ec. Retain any lime-green colour accent unchanged. Keep a strong smooth DARK CHARCOAL outer contour around every silver-filled form and the existing thin white outer keyline. Solid silver-filled letters, NEVER just hollow thin outline letters. Every pale silver shape must be uninterrupted flat opaque ink, no holes except the correct transparent counters. Background and gaps remain completely transparent. No speckles, missing patches, distress, texture, gradient, 3D, metallic lighting, glow, shadows, rectangle, extra text or mockup. One exact original horizontal logo with clean solid pale silver inside dark outlines, clear at small sizes on charcoal and red.
